thesis: Windows detection and logging done for small businesses through the MSPs that already run their IT: per-server logon and user-activity auditing, detection-aware reduction of the log noise that makes SIEMs unaffordable, and low-false-positive file-share ransomware canaries with guided restore. Researchers on all three gaps independently named the same wedge: cheap, done-for-you, sold via MSPs. Builds directly on the founder's WEF/Sysmon detection work.

paid_market_gaps.gap: Per-enabled-user licensing becomes very expensive for organizations with thousands of AD accounts
Microsoft 365 audit history beyond 180 days needs E5 or audit add-on per user; E3/Business tenants underserved
Each source (DCs, Entra tenants, file servers, workstations) is priced as a separate add-on, inflating mixed-estate cost
Free Linux session recording (tlog) is unreliable for root and loses recordings on reboot by default

market_research.wtp_evidence: Established auditing products publish prices SMBs buy (ADAudit Plus from $595/yr, Netwrix from $20/user); Netwrix Capterra reviewers mostly cite setup, reporting and usability issues; several praise its cost.
market_research.bundling_note: Microsoft (Purview Audit, 180 days standard) and AWS (90-day free CloudTrail event history) bundle native logs, but unified cross-system on-prem server/DB/AD review is not given away.
market_research.summary: Crowded, mature market (Netwrix, ManageEngine, Quest, Lepide, PAM vendors) with cloud-native logs bundled. Only narrow wedge: cheap, per-server-priced unified activity review plus long M365 retention for SMBs priced out of per-user tools.

threat.reason: Login and activity auditing helps detect valid-account misuse and lateral movement, mainly after the fact.

paid_market_gaps.gap: Teams drop logs to cut cost, creating forensic blind spots; need detection-aware filtering with cheap archive and rehydration
Independent pipeline vendors are being absorbed by SIEM/XDR vendors, shrinking vendor-neutral options
Pipeline tools are priced and built for enterprises (per-vCPU tiers, credits); small teams must author filters themselves
Free ingest grants cover only the SIEM vendor's own sources; third-party sources stay volume-billed

market_research.wtp_evidence: Large enterprises spend ~$2.5M/yr on logging and 67% say cost outweighs value; SentinelOne paid ~$225M for Observo. Small teams lean on flat-priced SMB SIEMs or free tiers.
market_research.bundling_note: Cribl gives 1TB/day free, Edge Delta reportedly made pipeline throughput free, Graylog Open is uncapped, and Microsoft Sentinel ingests Azure Activity/O365 audit logs free plus E5 grants.
market_research.summary: Crowded: Cribl, Datadog and SIEM-owned pipelines serve enterprises, flat-priced SMB SIEMs (Blumira, Huntress) bake in noise filtering, and free tiers abound. Thin opening only for detection-aware, vendor-neutral reduction packaged for MSPs or small teams.

threat.reason: Centralised log collection preserves evidence against log tampering and enables detection, indirectly.

paid_market_gaps.gap: File-server behavior detection (Varonis, Netwrix, Superna) is quote-only, enterprise-priced; little for 1-3 server shops
Storage-native detection locked to specific enterprise NAS platforms and multi-year capacity contracts
Deception/canary detection costly for small teams; median Thinkst Canary deal about $9,900/year
Endpoint anti-ransomware on file shares produces false positives blocking legitimate writes (e.g. AutoCAD exports)

market_research.wtp_evidence: Established paid backup and file-security products with public per-device and per-server prices (Acronis, Veeam, ManageEngine) sell widely; enterprise buyers pay large sums for Varonis.
market_research.bundling_note: Microsoft Defender for Business ($3/user/month, servers add-on) includes ransomware attack disruption, and Synology DSM offers immutable snapshots with ransomware-triggered snapshots.
market_research.summary: Crowded: backup vendors, EDR and enterprise file-security platforms all cover it, and Microsoft/NAS vendors bundle protection. Only narrow opening: cheap, low-false-positive file-share canary detection plus guided restore for 1-3 server SMBs or MSPs.

threat.reason: Ransomware detection and file restoration directly counters common, actively exploited encryption-for-impact attacks.
